first_run.subtitle: Translate your PDFs into your chosen language and read them side by side with the original.
first_run.info: ParaLate translates PDF documents through online translation services and interleaves them into a single PDF so you can read both languages side by side. Translating requires an internet connection. Your documents are stored encrypted.
first_run.accept: I have read and accept this information.
welcome.subtitle: Translate your PDFs into your chosen language and read them side by side with the original.
home.select_hint: FREE translates up to {limit} PDFs per day. The limit is 30 pages per PDF; longer PDFs require Premium.

history.clear_confirm: Delete all translated documents from history and their saved copies? This does not restore your daily translation quota.
history.empty: No translated documents yet. Start by selecting your first PDF.
history.delete_confirm: Delete this document? Deleting does not restore your daily translation quota.

language.heading: Which language should this document be translated into?

premium.heading: ParaLate Premium
premium.body: Premium removes daily translation and page limits, disables ads, allows saved documents to be opened offline, and lets you download PDFs.
premium.waiting: Please wait... Your Premium activation code is being verified.
premium.promo_heading: More freedom for your PDF translations
premium.promo_benefits:
• Removes the 30-page per-PDF limit
• Removes the daily free translation limit
• Open saved documents offline
• Download your translation as a PDF
• Disables ads
premium.promo_blocked: Close the Premium window to continue viewing the PDF.

ad.label: Ad
error.title: Error
error.internal: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.offline: No internet connection found. Translation and opening documents in FREE mode require an internet connection.
error.page_limit: This PDF has {p1} pages and is too long for FREE. The free version can translate up to {p2} pages per PDF. Premium is required for longer PDFs.
error.daily_limit: Your free daily translation quota is used up. Try again tomorrow or go Premium.
error.no_text: No processable text was found in this PDF.
error.corrupt_pdf: The PDF file could not be read. The file may be corrupted or use an unsupported PDF structure.
error.password_pdf: This PDF is password protected. Remove the password and try again.
error.provider_unavailable: The translation service is currently unreachable. Please try again later.
error.rate_limited: The translation service rate limit was exceeded. Wait a moment and try again.
error.auth_error: Authentication error from the translation service. Check your API key (see README).
error.timeout: The translation request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
error.bad_response: The translation service returned an unexpected response. Please try again.
error.not_supported: This language pair is not supported by the selected service.
error.database: Database error. Try restarting the application.
error.disk: The file could not be written. Check free disk space and permissions.
error.decrypt_failed: The document could not be opened: decryption failed. The file may be corrupted.
error.not_a_plt_file: This file is not a ParaLate document.
error.unsupported_version: Unsupported document version. Please update the application.
error.missing_file: The document file was not found.
error.interleave: An error occurred while combining pages.
